'''Gerbera Town''' (Japanese: '''ガーベラタウン''' ''Gerbera Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Sinnoh]]. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in the [[region]], it is home to a [[Contest Hall]], attracting several [[Pokémon Coordinator]]s who wish to compete in the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]].

It was featured during [[Marian]]'s [[television]] show in ''[[DP106|A Breed Stampede!]]'', in which it was revealed that {{si|Kenny}} had recently won a [[Pokémon Contest]] that was being held there, in the process earning his third [[Ribbon]] with the help of his {{TP|Kenny|Prinplup}}.
